The rich markdown editor cuts, copies and pastes: Cmd/Ctrl+C puts the text a reader sees on the clipboard as plain text (blocks on lines, table cells by tabs) and the selection's markdown as HTML styled in the light default theme (a dark-theme copy pastes readably into mail), and keeps the copied fragment process-wide, so pasting that copy back into any rich editor brings its bold, links and blocks exactly. Cmd/Ctrl+X copies and deletes as one undo step; a multi-cell table selection copies just the covered cells' text, what the cut clears, and a block the selection only touches (Shift+Down from a line's start) is not copied. Cmd/Ctrl+V reads any other clipboard text as markdown, so **bold**, lists, headings and tables paste formatted, except that a single line break stays a line break (a paragraph that would hold more than 20 becomes one paragraph per line). A lone paragraph goes into the text at the caret; otherwise the caret's block splits with the first paragraph joining the text before the caret and the last joined by the text after it, an empty line under the caret is replaced, and pasted blocks join the caret's list (one list, numbered on), quote or centered section instead of splitting it. A single plain line pastes in the caret's style, a code block takes plain text, a table cell a paragraph with its styles or else one line, verbatim markdown takes the document's line ending, a paste replaces the selection in its own undo step and lays the document out again, and a host gets PasteRequested first (to paste an image itself). RichPasteOperations holds the clipboard-free model: Slice, VisibleText, ParseClipboardText and InsertDocument; the widget's ApplyEdit takes an optional relayoutAll

The mouse wheel goes only to the topmost widget under the pointer and its ancestors: GuiWidget.OnMouseWheel stopped at nothing and offered every overlapping child the delta the one above it left, so a wheel over a non-scrolling part of a front window scrolled the window it covered. It now stops at the first visible, enabled, selectable child containing the point (skipping Selectable=false overlays like ScrollEdgeFade, as mouse-down does) and bubbles any unused delta up through that child's ancestors only
